2,404 likes, 109 comments - elleindia on April 3, 2025: "#ELLEImpact: Juhi Godambe Jain (@juhigodambe) is a digital content creator, entrepreneur, and fashion icon who has redefined the world of influencing. With a knack for creating luxe and stylish content, she has garnered a massive following over the years. As the founder of the fashion label Arabellaa, Juhi has seamlessly combined her passion for fashion with her entrepreneurial spirit. A mother, a businesswoman, and a strong advocate for authenticity, Juhi is the epitome of balance in both her professional and personal life, inspiring countless women to follow their dreams. Head to the 🔗 in bio to read more.
____________________________

1,418 likes, 11 comments - juhigodambe on October 8, 2026: "Some trips just stay with you, and our time at @patinamaldives was definitely one of them ❤️

One of the most memorable holidays we’ve taken with Aryan. He felt right at home from the minute we stepped onto the property. From the smallest little details being taken care of to the endless experiences we could enjoy together as a family, everything felt so thoughtful and special.

But more than anything, it was the beautiful time we got to spend together, making memories in the most incredible setting. A holiday we’ll cherish for a long, long time. 🥹

A big thank you to @coastalinofficial and @heavensportfolio.india for planning such a memorable getaway for us. It was truly special!

#PatinaMaldives #Maldives".
